title: Agent System Plugin Configuration Schema
description: Schema for the [plugin] table of a plugin.toml manifest

name.description: Unique plugin identifier (lowercase, alphanumeric, underscores, hyphens)

entrypoint.description: Python module path to plugin factory (e.g., 'plugin:PLUGIN_FACTORY'). Required for every type except 'library' (config only) and 'llm-provider' (found through provider.py) -- validate_plugin.py enforces that condition.

type.description: Plugin capabilities as a list. Combine values to describe multi-capability plugins.

provides.description: LLM provider names this plugin serves (type 'llm-provider'). agent_system.llm.registry scans the manifests for this key and never imports the plugin until a model actually names one of them; a `provider:` in llm.yaml that no manifest claims fails config load.

provides_batch.description: Batch backend names this plugin serves (agent_system.llm.registry, `provides_batch`). A model with provider: batch resolves its real client through this.

provides_tts.description: TTS provider names this plugin serves (agent_system.llm.registry, `provides_tts`).

provides_decisions.description: Decision model provider names this plugin serves (agent_system.llm.registry, `provides_decisions`). A decision model answers named questions with a typed value and a probability -- no chat; entries live under llm_system.decision_models.

default_base_url.description: Per-provider default endpoint, {provider: url}. Read by agent_system.llm.registry; must be a table, anything else is ignored with a warning.

lazy.description: Opt-in: servers of this type may be built on first use instead of at start. A contract about the constructor -- config and an LLM client, no I/O, no thread, no socket -- and only agent plugins qualify: agent_system.runtime refuses to register a lazy type that builds anything other than an Agent.

visibility.description: Default visibility for servers of this type, used when the instance's own metadata sets none (agent_system.runtime, ServerDecl.visibility). No shipped manifest declares one today; the key was missing here although the runtime has always read it, so the first manifest to use it would have been rejected.

tags.description: Tags for plugin discovery and search

optional_dependencies.description: Python package dependencies whose install may fail without breaking the install (requirements/optional.txt, installed best effort by the install scripts)

tools.description: List of tools provided by this plugin

web.description: Web endpoint configuration for hybrid plugins

config.description: Default configuration for the plugin (serves as documentation)

hooks.description: Hook declarations for plugin lifecycle integration

name.description: Unique hook identifier (must be unique across all plugins)

enabled.description: Whether hook is enabled by default

before.description: List of hook names this hook should execute before

after.description: List of hook names this hook should execute after
